'''Valga Djenn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian shock trooper|shock trooper]] and a [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast master]] of [[Clan Ha'rangir]]. She participated in the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]] against [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|Mandalore the Avenger's faction]] and was killed in the fighting along with her [[tineback]]s [[Bite]] and [[Bark (Tineback)|Bark]].<ref name="Ruhnuk" />
